dct_description_sm: The purpose of this project was to support Inuit Tapiriit Kanatami (ITK) in the investigation on the state of knowledge with respect to climate change vulnerability and adaptation among Inuit regions. The results from this year's project provide baseline outcomes for assessing the future state of knowledge and associated gaps in information in climate change vulnerability and adaptation, particularly with respect to specific issues areas outlined, for example, infrastructure, fishery, economy, land and resources management, health, water, wildlife, or other relevant issues for the Inuit communities. More specifically, the project helped ITK to identify and gather the appropriate information and resources to ensure engagement of Inuit at the regional level and assist project partners.
